units.source_text: 這所中學的附近有我家的一個遠房親戚，或許是這個原因，父親為我挑選了這所毗鄰大海和開滿櫻花的中學。

en.t: Near this middle school lived a distant relative of my family; perhaps for that reason, my father chose for me this school beside the sea and full of cherry blossoms.

units.source_text: 我寄宿在那位親戚家裡，因為離學校很近，每天都是聽到學校晨訓的鐘聲後，才飛奔到學校。

en.t: I boarded at that relative's house, and since it was very close to the school, every day I would wait until I heard the bell for morning assembly and then dash off to school.

units.source_text: 我雖是一位相當懶惰的中學生，但由於憑靠自己搞笑的本領，在同學中的人氣日益攀升。

en.t: Although I was a rather lazy middle school student, my popularity among my classmates rose day by day thanks to my talent for clowning around.

units.source_text: 這是我有生以來第一次離開家生活，但在我看來，生活在他鄉遠比在自己的故鄉活得更輕鬆自在。

en.t: This was the first time in my life that I had lived away from home, but to me life in another place felt far easier and freer than life in my own hometown.

units.source_text: 或許也可以這樣解釋：我搞笑的本領已逐漸得心應手，欺騙人時已不像以往那麼費勁了。

en.t: Perhaps one could also explain it this way: my knack for clowning had gradually become second nature, and deceiving people no longer took as much effort as before.
